reviewer: denotation chapter agent; ClosureBounds author and independent reader of ClosureCorrespondence
claims_reviewed: evalBound constructs an existential finite derivation bound from every Eval derivation; no global fuel bound or termination premise beyond the given derivation is introduced.
weakenBound preserves exact source and result for arbitrary LTE evidence, and forgetBound reconstructs the same Eval judgment.
boundedToClos uses fuel descent at application and finite closure/environment structural descent at variable lookup; no termination override is present.
evalToClos quantifies over every Closure and every closed result term, and constructs a ClosEval result with exact equality between its reification and the original result.
ClosValue ensures that the obtained function closure is a lambda; lambdaInjective and reifyBeta transport the body evaluation through capture-avoiding closing substitution.
The theorem does not assume environment entries have already evaluated, and does not reduce closure evaluation to a fixed selection of examples.
